slides.headline: ONE FOUNDER USED 6 AI PROMPTS AND KNEW MORE ABOUT A RIVAL THAN THE RIVAL'S OWN TEAM DID
slides.kicker: THEY'RE ALREADY DOING IT TO YOU

slides.headline: 1) STEAL THEIR UNHAPPY CUSTOMERS
slides.body: Finding out what competitors' customers hate used to mean hiring a research firm. "Here are my competitor's Google reviews. List every complaint that appears 3+ times and write me a targeted ad for each pain point"

slides.headline: 2) REVERSE-ENGINEER THEIR PRICING
slides.body: Decoding a competitor's pricing strategy used to mean hiring a consultant. "Here is my competitor's pricing page. Break down their strategy, find every psychological trigger, and show me where to undercut them"

slides.headline: 3) PREDICT THEIR NEXT MOVE
slides.body: Job listings reveal a competitor's strategy 6 months early. "Here are my competitor's open roles. Tell me what they're building, what market they're entering, and how I should respond"

slides.headline: 4) FIND WHAT THEY'RE IGNORING
slides.body: Your competitor's customers are begging for features nobody builds. "Compare my competitor's product page against their customer reviews. List every feature request they keep ignoring, ranked by frequency"

slides.headline: 5) WALK THEIR WEBSITE LIKE A CUSTOMER
slides.body: Mapping how a competitor sells online used to require an agency engagement. "Go through my competitor's website as a first-time buyer. Map every step from landing to checkout and tell me where they lose people"

slides.headline: 6) BUILD A CHEAT SHEET IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: One page that gives your team an edge in every competitor call. "Here is my product and my top competitor. Write a one-page comparison: their weaknesses, our strengths, and a response to every objection"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT STRATEGY SESSION
slides.body:
